recipe.title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
recipe.description: A quick and comforting pasta dish with tender chicken, creamy sauce, and Parmesan cheese. Perfect for an easy lunch or dinner.
recipe.photoAlt: Pasta with mushrooms and fresh herbs, shown as serving inspiration.

pasta.title: Cook the pasta
pasta.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water following the package instructions. Reserve a small cup of the cooking water, then drain.

chicken.title: Prepare the chicken
chicken.text: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the chicken until cooked through. Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.

sauce.title: Make the sauce
sauce.text: Lower the heat, add the cream, and stir in the Parmesan. Add a little reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick.

serve.title: Combine and serve
serve.text: Add the pasta to the pan and stir to coat. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve with fresh parsley.

recipe.tipsText: For a richer flavor, add mushrooms or spinach. Reserve some pasta water to adjust the sauce.
recipe.saladAlt: A colorful salad with avocado and fresh vegetables.

alex.text: Easy to follow and perfect for a weekday dinner.

sam.text: I added mushrooms and a little extra Parmesan.

jamie.text: The pasta water tip made the sauce really smooth.
